book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: بمحطة القطار، التقى صاحبين من أيام المدرسة.
sentences.en: At the railway station, two old school friends met.

sentences.ar: واحد تخين، طالع من المطعم، وشفافه لامعة زي الكرز الناضج، وريحته نبيذ وعطر.
sentences.en: One fat, just out of the restaurant, his lips shining like ripe cherries, smelling of wine and scent.

sentences.ar: وواحد نحيف، نازل من القطار، محمل بشناتي وصناديق، وريحته لحم مدخن وقهوة.
sentences.en: And one thin, just off the train, loaded with bags and boxes, smelling of ham and coffee.

sentences.ar: ووراه مرته، نحيفة كمان، وابنه، طويل، وعينه ضيقة.
sentences.en: And behind him his wife, thin as well, and his son, tall, narrow-eyed.
The fat one cried: Porfiry!
You?
My friend!
The thin one cried: Misha!
Good Lord!
Where from?

sentences.ar: وتعانقوا، وباسوا بعض تلات مرات، وعيونهم مليانة دمع.
sentences.en: And they embraced, kissed three times, their eyes full of tears.
The thin one said: my dear!
I never expected!
This is my wife, Louisa.
And this my son, Nathanael.
In the third class.
Nathanael, this is my school friend!

sentences.ar: والولد فكر شوي، وبعدين شلح قبعته.
sentences.en: And the boy thought a moment, and then took off his cap.

sentences.ar: قال النحيف: بتتذكر كيف كانوا يسموك بالمدرسة؟
sentences.en: The thin one said: do you remember what they called you at school?
Herostratus, because you burned a book with a cigarette!
And me Ephialtes, because I told tales!
Ha ha!
And what has become of you?
Married?
Where do you work?
The fat one said: I work.
And you?

sentences.ar: قال النحيف: أنا موظف، بالدرجة التامنة، من سنتين.
sentences.en: The thin one said: I am a clerk, eighth grade, two years now.

sentences.ar: الراتب قليل، بس مرتي بتعطي دروس موسيقى، وأنا بصنع علب سجاير من الخشب.
sentences.en: The pay is small, but my wife gives music lessons, and I make cigarette cases out of wood.
And sell them at a rouble each.
And if you take ten, there is a discount!
The thin one said: and you?
Surely you are fifth grade by now!
Eh?
The fat one said: no, my dear.
A little higher.
I am a privy councillor.
And I have two stars.
And suddenly, the thin one went white, and turned to stone.

sentences.ar: وبعدين وجهه لف بكل الاتجاهات، وابتسم ابتسامة عريضة، زي إنه بيتألم.
sentences.en: And then his face twisted in every direction, and smiled a wide smile, as if in pain.

sentences.ar: وكأنه هو ومرته وابنه وشناتيه وصناديقه صاروا أزغر.
sentences.en: And it was as if he and his wife and his son and his bags and his boxes had all grown smaller.
And the boy buttoned his shirt to the top.

sentences.ar: قال النحيف: أنا... يا سعادتك... تشرفنا... يا سعادتك...
sentences.en: The thin one said: I... Your Excellency... honoured... Your Excellency...
The fat one said: enough!
What is this tone?
We are school friends!

sentences.ar: قال النحيف: بالله عليك... سعادتك بتتفضل... واحد زيي، وسعادتك... ها ها.
sentences.en: The thin one said: for pity's sake... Your Excellency is too kind... one like me, and Your Excellency... ha ha.

sentences.ar: وهاد ابني نثنائيل يا سعادتك... ومرتي لويزا... بشكل ما...
sentences.en: And this is my son Nathanael, Your Excellency... and my wife Louisa... in a manner of speaking...

sentences.ar: التخين كان بده يعترض، بس شاف وجه النحيف.
sentences.en: The fat one wanted to protest, but saw the thin one's face.

sentences.ar: كله تقوى، وحلاوة، واحترام، لدرجة إنه المستشار السري غثى.
sentences.en: All piety, and sweetness, and respect, so much that the privy councillor felt sick.
And turned away, and held out his hand in farewell.

sentences.ar: والنحيف مسك تلات أصابع، وانحنى بكل جسمه، وضحك زي الصيني: هي هي هي.
sentences.en: And the thin one took three fingers, bowed with his whole body, and laughed like a Chinaman: hee hee hee.
And his wife smiled.

sentences.ar: ونثنائيل ضرب بإجره الأرض، وطيّر قبعته.
sentences.en: And Nathanael clicked his heels, and dropped his cap.
And all three were overcome with joy.
